name: Anak
overview: The biblical figure Anak is identified as the father of three giants, named Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, who were driven out by Caleb as part of the conquest of the land given to the children of Judah. Anak's legacy is closely tied to the city of Arba, also known as Hebron, which was allotted to Caleb according to the LORD's command to Joshua. These passages highlight Anak's role as a progenitor of formidable inhabitants in the hill country of Judah, emphasizing God's provision and victory through His chosen leaders.
